title: Multi-Site runtime notification burst coalescing
opportunity: The PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY listener treated every queued notification as a separate runtime reload even though notification payloads are wake-up hints and each reload reads the authoritative database snapshot.
implementation: Ignore wake-ups that do not contain a parsed queued notification.
Drain the rest of the current bounded notification burst before activating the runtime snapshot.
Perform one retryable authoritative reload for the drained burst, preserving the existing timeout, retry, and status behavior.
boundary: Live PostgreSQL burst notification and YARP reload latency benchmark
Authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke and visual responsive verification
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
